info.text:
67% of Gen Z partners have kept a money secret.

Bankrate (Jan 2025): 40% of US adults living with a partner have committed financial infidelity; Gen Z 67%, boomers 30%.
What's hidden: overspending 33%, secret debt 23%, a secret card 17%, a secret savings account 15%.
Example: a $3,000 secret card balance at 19.63% APR (Bankrate average, Sept 30, 2026) costs $588.90 in a year before compounding.
Bankrate (Jan 2026): 43% say money secrets are at least as bad as physical cheating.

Sources: Bankrate/YouGov surveys (Jan 2025, Jan 2026); Bankrate weekly card rate survey.
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
